item.title: Easter Bible Quotes - Scriptures about Easter
item.description: Find Bible verses about the Easter holiday including the crucifixion, resurrection and eternal salvation of Jesus Christ.

item.title: 9 Easy Easter Crafts And Decorations To Celebrate The Resurrection Of Jesus
item.description: This Easter season, rediscover the true meaning behind the holiday by focusing on Jesus' resurrection and its significance in Christian faith. Explore easy and creative crafts that help illustrate the story of Jesus' resurrection, such as building an Easter Peep house or creating a Resurrection Garden, to make this Easter one to remember.

item.title: Her Childhood Pen Pal Turned Out to Be the OB-GYN Who Delivered Her Kids
item.description: What began as a childhood pen pal friendship turned into a remarkable full-circle moment years later. The same person she once wrote letters to became the OB-GYN who delivered her children.

item.title: 90-Year-Old Navy Veteran Goes Parasailing and Brings His Doctor Along to Fulfill a Promise
item.description: At 90 years old, a Navy veteran took to the skies for a parasailing adventure—bringing his doctor along to fulfill a heartfelt promise. Their shared experience became a powerful reminder that it’s never too late to embrace life’s adventures.

item.title: Rejoice with These Top Easter Songs for Worship and Praise
item.description: Celebrate the joy of Easter with uplifting songs that inspire worship and praise. These top Easter hymns fill hearts with gratitude and reverence for the resurrection.

item.title: 10 Easter Songs Make A Stunning Resurrection Medley To Help You Rejoice
item.description: This Easter Resurrection Medley by Willow Worship features a powerful collection of classic songs that remind us of the true meaning of the season, honoring Jesus' death and resurrection. The medley, performed by talented singers from Willow Creek Community Church, is a beautiful tribute to God's love and sacrifice, sure to touch your soul.

item.title: 7 Favorite Hymns For An Easter Service
item.description: Here are seven great hymns for an Easter Service.

item.title: A Fire Broke Out So a UPS Driver and Caring Neighbors Rushed to Save 101-Year-Old Woman
item.description: When a fire broke out, a UPS driver and quick-acting neighbors rushed to help a 101-year-old woman in danger. Their compassion and courage turned a frightening moment into a life-saving rescue.

item.title: He Survived the Night With Prayers After Getting Lost On a Hike, Clinging to Jesus and His Faith
item.description: Lost and alone during a long night on a hike, one man held tightly to his faith, praying through every moment of uncertainty. By morning, his survival became a powerful testament to hope, perseverance, and trust in Jesus.
